Frequently Asked Questions — Tulsa

How fast can you buy my Tulsa house?

We can close in as little as 7 days. After you request an offer, we contact you within 24 hours, schedule a quick walkthrough, and present a no-obligation cash offer. You pick the closing date — 7 days or 60 days, your call.

Do I need to make repairs before selling my Tulsa home?

No. We buy houses in Tulsa in as-is condition — fire damage, water damage, foundation issues, outdated kitchens, hoarder situations, bad tenants. You don't clean, fix, or stage anything.

Are there any fees or commissions when selling in Tulsa?

Zero. No agent commissions, no closing costs, no hidden fees. The cash offer we make is the amount you receive at closing.

How do you determine your cash offer in Tulsa?

We base offers on recent comparable sales in Tulsa and Tulsa County, your property's condition and location, and current local market conditions. Our offers are competitive and transparent — no surprise deductions at closing.

What if I owe more on my mortgage or I'm behind on payments?

We buy homes with existing mortgages all the time — we pay off the mortgage at closing and you keep the remaining equity. If you're facing foreclosure in Tulsa, our fast closing can often help you avoid it hitting your credit.

Do you buy inherited or vacant properties in Tulsa?

Yes — inherited homes, vacant properties, and even homes with code violations are some of our most common purchases in the Tulsa area. We'll handle the headaches so you don't have to.

Is your Tulsa cash offer really no-obligation?

Completely. You can decline our offer for any reason with zero pressure. Most Tulsa homeowners accept because the offer is fair and the process is fast, but the choice is always yours.
